correctness.rationale: The exact event and quantifiers are three disjoint nonempty guilds, iid species survival p in (0,1), a two-survivor quorum within each guild and at least two successful guilds. Inclusion–exclusion gives R=r_ar_b+r_ar_c+r_br_c−2r_ar_br_c. Exact factorized differences classify all unordered S<=7 allocations, with the unique crossover at p=1/2. For S>=7 low-p leading coefficient is positive in six S modulo 6 classes; high-p failure-exponent comparison reverses the ranking of A_S and B_S (S=7 coefficients 6 vs 4). The claim correctly does not classify all global S>7 optimizers. Independently enumerated all survivor masks/all S<=7 partitions and checked symbolic factors and positive leading coefficients through S=500, which corroborate rather than prove the unbounded six-class algebra.
